# Robotechs FTC 25611

> Robotechs is a twelve-student FIRST Tech Challenge team (25611) from Clarksburg, Maryland. The team designs, builds, and programs competition robots and shares STEM through robot demos, community workshops, and free robotics and CAD tutorials.

## Key facts

- Team: Robotechs, FIRST Tech Challenge (FTC) team 25611
- Location: Clarksburg, Maryland, USA
- Members: twelve students; roles cover engineering, programming, design, media, outreach, event planning, and fundraising
- Contact: robot3chs@gmail.com
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/robotechsftc/
- YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@robotechsftc
- FTCScout team page: https://ftcscout.org/teams/25611
- Seasons documented: 2024-25 INTO THE DEEP, 2025-26 DECODE, and the 2026-27 season in progress
- Awards: Sustain Award and Reach Award (2025-26 DECODE); Control Award 2nd place and Finalist Alliance 1st pick (2024-25 INTO THE DEEP)

## Pages

- [Robotechs FTC 25611](https://www.robotechsftc.org/): Robotechs FTC 25611 is a student FIRST Tech Challenge robotics team in Clarksburg, Maryland. Explore our robots, competitions, STEM outreach, and tutorials.
- [About Our Clarksburg Robotics Team](https://www.robotechsftc.org/about): Meet Robotechs FTC 25611, a twelve-student robotics team from Clarksburg, Maryland. Get to know our members, skills, teamwork, and award-winning FTC seasons. (public, but intentionally noindex for search engines)
- [Robot Engineering](https://www.robotechsftc.org/engineering): Explore our 2025–26 Decode robot, nine development milestones, and photo archive. Follow our 2026–27 robot as it takes shape.
- [Robotics Events & Competitions](https://www.robotechsftc.org/events): Follow Robotechs FTC 25611 at robotics competitions, community demos, and STEM workshops in Clarksburg, Maryland, and beyond. Find dates, locations, and photos.
- [STEM Outreach in Clarksburg & Beyond](https://www.robotechsftc.org/outreach): See how Robotechs FTC 25611 shares STEM with Clarksburg, Maryland, and nearby communities through robot demos, mentoring, workshops, and free learning resources.
- [FTC Robotics & Onshape Tutorials](https://www.robotechsftc.org/tutorials): Learn FTC robotics and beginner Onshape CAD with Robotechs video tutorials. Find our YouTube channel and Onshape playlist.
- [Support Our Robotics Team](https://www.robotechsftc.org/support): Support Robotechs FTC 25611 through sponsorship, robotics equipment, competition travel, and hands-on STEM outreach.
- [Contact Our Clarksburg Team](https://www.robotechsftc.org/contact): Contact Robotechs FTC 25611 in Clarksburg, Maryland, about robotics demos, STEM workshops, sponsorship, or joining our community. Email robot3chs@gmail.com.

## Events

- [2025 Richmond, VA Qualifier I](https://www.robotechsftc.org/event-2025-richmond-va-qualifier-i): Our first qualifier of the 2025–26 season took us to Richmond, Virginia, where we met new teams and competed in DECODE matches.
- [Manassas Qualifier II](https://www.robotechsftc.org/event-2026-manassas-qualifier-ii): Robotechs will compete at Manassas Qualifier II on December 13, 2026 at Osbourn High School in Manassas, Virginia.
- [2026 Union Bridge, MD Qualifier I](https://www.robotechsftc.org/event-2026-union-bridge-md-qualifier-i): On January 24, we competed in our final DECODE season qualifier in Union Bridge, Maryland, meeting new teams and playing a full day of matches.
- [Baltimore Qualifier I](https://www.robotechsftc.org/event-2027-baltimore-qualifier-i): Robotechs will compete at Baltimore Qualifier I on January 16, 2027 at Mount Saint Joseph High School in Baltimore, Maryland.
- [Martinsville Qualifier I](https://www.robotechsftc.org/event-2027-martinsville-qualifier-i): Robotechs will compete at Martinsville Qualifier I on January 9, 2027 at Patrick & Henry Community College in Martinsville, Virginia.
- [Advocating for STEM & Robotics with Community Leaders](https://www.robotechsftc.org/event-advocating-for-stem-robotics-with-community-leaders): We met with community leaders and elected officials to discuss robotics, STEM, and how students can use technology to solve real-world problems.
- [Girl Scouts: Intro to Robotics](https://www.robotechsftc.org/event-girls-scout-demo): Girl Scouts saw the Robotechs competition robot in action and learned about robotics basics, programming, CAD design, and building.
- [Hands-On Science Fun!](https://www.robotechsftc.org/event-hands-on-science-fun): Robotechs and Rocket Robotics collaborated for robot demonstrations and interactive STEM activities on November 2, 2026, from 1:00 to 3:00 PM in Washington, DC.
- [Robotics Demo and Outreach: Lipi Language School](https://www.robotechsftc.org/event-hindi-class-robotics-demo): The Robotechs Hindi class robotics demo with Lipi Language School is postponed. A new date and location will be announced.
- [HWMS STEAM NIGHT](https://www.robotechsftc.org/event-hwms-steam-night): We participated in STEAM Night at Hallie Wells Middle School alongside FTC Team 47 Beavers.
- [MCPL Robotics Event](https://www.robotechsftc.org/event-mcpl-robotics-event): Robotechs joined Firewall Robotics and Photon Phoenix at Gaithersburg Library for robot demonstrations, LEGO building, and hands-on STEM challenges during the Maryland STEM Festival.
- [MCPL STEM Event](https://www.robotechsftc.org/event-mcpl-stem-event): Our Launch into Robotics event at Germantown Library introduced students to FIRST, FTC robots, and the world of STEAM.
- [RoboFest](https://www.robotechsftc.org/event-robofest): On October 25, we hosted RoboFest at Snowden Farm Elementary School to share STEM with our community.
- [Robotechs FTC - Summer Course](https://www.robotechsftc.org/event-robotechs-ftc-summer-course): Robotechs FTC - Summer Course: event details, venue, and dates from the Robotechs FTC 25611 event archive.
- [STEM-tober FEST](https://www.robotechsftc.org/event-stem-tober-fest): At Germantown Library, we joined other FIRST teams for STEMtober FEST, bringing robotics, creativity, and hands-on STEM learning to our community.
- [Robotics Demo and Outreach: SiliconAndhra ManaBadi](https://www.robotechsftc.org/event-telugu-class-robotics-demo): Robotechs held a Telugu class robotics demo on October 31, 2026, from 11:30 AM to 12:30 PM at Little Bennett Elementary School in Clarksburg, Maryland.
